text: And the candy store? <#0.35#> In nineteen seventy two, Buffett and Charlie Munger bought See's through Blue Chip Stamps. <#0.2#> They paid twenty five million dollars. <#0.2#> By his letter for nineteen ninety nine, See's had earned eight hundred and fifty seven million. <#0.2#> Before tax.
